user_prompt: I need to simultaneously pull together our current spending commitments with a specific vendor and cross-reference that against our latest payroll records to reconcile Q4 budget allocations and ensure our procurement expenses align with employee compensation costs for audit purposes.

steps.step_name: Pull our current spending commitments with a specific vendor

args.content:
LANDSCAPE SYSTEMS (10 visible):
- workday.hcm: HCM - compensation agents only, NO REST API for staffing data
- sap.sf: SuccessFactors HCM - REST API: EmployeeCompensationManagement:v1 (READ payroll/compensation data). KEY AGENT: SkillsAndCapabilityMatchingOrchestrator:v1 for workforce capability assessment
- sap.s4: ERP - MaterialReceiptInboundAPI (INBOUND REST API for goods receipt), Procurement agents (ProcurementMatchingAgent), OpportunityToOrderAutomationEngine, AssetLifecycleChangeOrchestrator
- sap.crm: CRM - sales/marketing agents ONLY - NO performance analytics APIs
- sap.ehs: Safety/health - AGENTS for vendor safety compliance: VendorComplianceAutomationOrchestrator (validates vendor safety certifications and EHS compliance status), SafetyComplianceAutomationCoordinator
- sap.ariba: Procurement - PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI (REST API for PO lifecycle, creation, approval, real-time status tracking - COVERS SPENDING COMMITMENTS), VendorInvoiceReconciliation, SourceingCampaignAndAccountManagementAPI
- corp.itsm: IT service mgmt - agents ONLY - NO create API for maintenance submission
- emarsys.cx: CX/marketing - agents only
- my.mes: Manufacturing - EquipmentOEEAnalytics, ProductionQualityMonitor
- siemens.plm: PLM - SupplierQualificationAndMaterialCoordinator (vendor assessment + material approval), EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning, BOMComplianceValidator
- sap.odm: Data model (entity taxonomy only)

KEY FOR VENDOR SPENDING: sap.ariba:apiResource:PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI:v1 = REST API for PO lifecycle, status tracking, exposes PurchaseOrder+Vendor entities. POs ARE spending commitments.

args.reason: REST API for purchase order lifecycle management with real-time status tracking of vendor commitments and spending orders.
